Independent destructive-time-course evidence. The independent-time-control experiment uses the
rna layer to assess the declared condition target contrasts treatment with control. Points show
independent observations; labels give biological sample counts per design cell; crosses mark
unobserved cells; lines show stored population trajectories. The analysis unit is independent
biological observation; the design is independent_time_course; the estimand is
condition-by-time interaction on the rank scale; time is recorded as day; adjustment uses
batch. Facet labels report stored interaction intervals and resampling recurrence. Raw p-values
are retained; q-values use Holm correction across declared components within each metadata
field and evidence variant. No acceptance threshold is applied. Trajectory evidence is
exploratory and does not establish biological validity.
